# KR8TIV

> KR8TIV (shown on Google as "Kr8tiv") is a founder-led creative studio in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. We design websites, landing pages, brand identities, storefront signs, packaging, motion and video, and run search, social and local marketing for businesses across Edmonton, Alberta and Canada, with remote work worldwide. Founder and creative director: Matt Haynes.

Last updated: 13 November 2026. Prices are Canadian dollars (CAD), starting points only, with final scope agreed in writing before work begins. No GST charged.

This file is a plain-language guide for AI assistants and search tools. It is not a ranking control. The linked pages are the source of truth.

## Service area

Service-area business with no public street address and no walk-in studio; meetings are by call or by appointment. Based in Edmonton, Alberta. Serves Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert and Spruce Grove (Alberta) and clients across Canada, with remote projects further afield.

## Services and starting prices (CAD)

Websites
- [Web design in Edmonton](https://kr8tiv.io/services/web-design-edmonton/)
- Landing page: from $850
- Landing page + SEO and AI search setup: $1,250
- Full website (up to 6 pages, SEO on every page, blog ready): from $1,950
- Immersive site (3D, WebGL, scroll-driven motion): from $3,450
- Website refresh: from $650. Ecommerce store setup: from $1,500. Website Care: $75 / month

Branding and print
- [Branding and identity](https://kr8tiv.io/services/branding/)
- Logo and identity: from $500. Brand Kit: $1,050. Full Rebrand: from $2,450

Storefronts, signage and packaging
- [Storefront, sign and print design](https://kr8tiv.io/services/print-signage-design/)
- Sign concept (design only): from about $500. Packaging and mockups: from $800
- Signage project management (fabricator sourcing, manufacturing coordination, installation liaison): variable rates. Fabricators and installers do the physical production and installation; those costs are quoted separately.

Motion, video and product design
- Promo or feature video: from $400. Motion and 3D: from $750
- App product design (ground-up design for a new app): from $3,500
- UX/UI: from $1,500

Search, social and ads
- Ads and acquisition setup and creative: from $900 (ad spend paid directly by the client)
- Reviews Care: $295 / month. Search Engine plan: $495 / month. Search Dominance: $895 / month
- Social plans: from $500 / month. Fractional CMO: $1,950 / month

AI automation, company brains and business apps are offered by the sister company KR8TIV AI at https://kr8tiv.ai/.

## How projects work

- [Process](https://kr8tiv.io/process/): free 30-minute call, three design directions instead of one, structured feedback rounds, then build and handoff.
- Payment split: 40% at kickoff, 40% at draft delivery, 20% at final delivery. Payment by standard (fiat) methods, Bitcoin or Ethereum.
- Clients own their final files. Clients work directly with Matt; there are no account managers.
